Process $V_F$ using a 2-layer MLP with hidden dimension 512 to learn the depth of each feature in the grid.
Use three separate 2-layer MLPs (hidden dimension 512) to output learned weights $w_i$ over the volumetric feature dimensions.
Apply softmax to the weights $w$ and sum over the respective orthogonal dimensions to obtain 2D feature maps for the three planes (xy, xz, yz).

For a 3D point $\mathbf{x}$, project it into each of the three planes by extracting absolute coordinates (xy, xz, yz).
Concatenate the sampled features and sum over the channel dimension.
Sample directly into the encoder feature map $F_I$ to retrieve local residual features.
Concatenate the encoded position $\mathbf{x}$, tri-planar features $f_{tp}$, and residual features $f_r$.
Use the first 4 layers of the Rendering MLP to output features of dimension $N \times 128$.
Use two additional dedicated MLP layers (hidden dimension 128) to output a 3-channel color value $\mathbf{c}$ for every sampled point $N$.
